answer: Agents register through cryptographic attestation chains verified by zero-knowledge proofs, linking stake to unique hardware enclaves. Any attempt to mirror real identities turns identity proofs into a hollow fable, as the network enforces exponential capital exhaustion on duplicate clusters: staking bonds scale as O(2^n) per identity, imposing an exponential cost on Sybil swarms that renders coordinated replication economically unviable.
